render.truncation: none at render time; observations carry the harness's own >= 10,000-character elision
render.submit_command: the teacher's final `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT && cat patch.txt` is rewritten to the lone `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` our harness prompt asks for; every other turn is verbatim
render.reference_patch_rule: a trajectory is dropped when its prompt (system + user text) contains any non-test added lines of >= 12 non-blank characters of the reference patch

repo_root.rule: commands lose a leading `cd /testbed && ` (or ; or newline) and a leading `cd /testbed/<sub> &&` becomes `cd <sub> &&`; then /testbed at a path start (start, whitespace, quote, =, :, (, `, [, {, comma, <, >) and a name end becomes the repository root in every message (observations on the parsed output); episodes with a command the rewrite could change (bare word testbed, a skipped /testbed path, cd /testbed && cd ..) are dropped as repo_root_ambiguous

draw.strata: big = >= 3 non-test files and >= 100 added lines; feature = >= 3 files or >= 50 added lines; random = the rest (reference patch without test files, apex_data.grade.tamper.classify_path)
draw.trajectory_choice_rule: among the instance's trajectories that pass every gate and fit the cap, the one with the fewest assistant turns among those that ran a test command after their last file edit (apex_data.teacher.verify); ties by rendered tokens, then trajectory id; when none of them did, random_not_shortest. A pinned instance keeps its slot and gets its trajectory by this rule

trajectory_features.source: assistant tool-call arguments of the raw Open-SWE-Traces messages, in order

draw.lineage: one row per (repository, PR) across both subsources

max_turn_completion_tokens.rule: a gate-passing trajectory whose rendered row has an assistant turn of more than the cap in trained tokens (its contiguous assistant_masks span) fails at stage turn_length (turn_too_long); kept selections whose trajectory fails are replaced like any other failing kept row

row_filters.note: teacher identity, thinking mode and upstream dataset asserted per row
